use: Architecture review and phased refactoring plan for a large repository using Recursive Language Model (RLM) decomposition. Use when asked to plan a refactor, find circular or tangled dependencies, split or merge modules, or assess coupling in code too large to read in one pass.

steps.note: Inspect. Run `python3 <skill>/scripts/rlm_corpus.py scan <repo>` for the size and layout.
Map. For each chunk, run a fresh sub-task (a subagent if you can start one) that sees only that chunk file and the "Chunk task" below.
Verify. For each cycle and each high-impact recommendation, open the files and confirm the coupling is real before recommending a change.

protocol.title: Inspect
protocol.text: Run `python3 <skill>/scripts/rlm_corpus.py scan <repo>` for the size and layout. If the repo is very large, agree the scope with the user and narrow it with `--include 'src/*'` (repeatable) on every command. Files over 20 MB are skipped; report what `scan` lists as skipped.

protocol.title: Graph
protocol.text: Run `python3 <skill>/scripts/rlm_corpus.py graph <repo>`. It prints each file's local imports, the import cycles, and the most-imported files. Keep this output in your working notes; it is the backbone of the plan.

protocol.title: Partition
protocol.text: Run `WORK=$(mktemp -d)`, then `python3 <skill>/scripts/rlm_corpus.py chunk <repo> "$WORK/chunks"`. Chunks are limited to 800 lines and 100,000 characters each, and are cut between definitions where possible.

protocol.title: Map
protocol.text: For each chunk, run a fresh sub-task (a subagent if you can start one) that sees only that chunk file and the "Chunk task" below. It writes `"$WORK/out/<chunk>.out.md"`. If you cannot start sub-tasks, run `python3 <skill>/scripts/rlm_corpus.py pending "$WORK/chunks" "$WORK/out"` and process the first listed chunk: read it, write its output, then run `pending` again until nothing is pending.

protocol.title: Reduce
protocol.text: Run `python3 <skill>/scripts/rlm_corpus.py merge "$WORK/out" --out "$WORK/merged.json"`. Re-run any `failed_outputs`. A broken output is not "no issues". Repeat the map step on the merged findings if they are still too large.

protocol.title: Verify
protocol.text: For each cycle and each high-impact recommendation, open the files and confirm the coupling is real before recommending a change.

protocol.title: Plan
protocol.text: Write the plan in the format below.

protocol.title: Clean up
protocol.text: Delete `$WORK` after the plan is delivered.
